Marta: Heads-up — seeing a p50 latency bump (~18%) on staging after yesterday's runtime changes. Looks correlated with structured-output requests that invoke tools a lot. :eyes:
Raj: which change specifically? kernel selection or batching heuristics?
Marta: I think it's the queue policy + token budget tweak we flipped (lower token_budget_target). On traces the decode scheduler forms many tiny batches when a request pauses for a tool call, and stop-token chasing causes early flushes.
Eli: can you paste a trace? small snippets help.
Marta: pasted below — see the sequence where a chat request emits structured JSON, runtime triggers tool pause, decoder yields, batch fragments, KV cache gets evicted and later repopulated.
```
TRACE 1961122334.120: request_id=stg-42 queue_pos=3 queue_wait_ms=14 tokens_emitted=12 -> tool_pause
TRACE 1961122334.218: batch_formed size=2 avg_tokens=9 latency=38ms
TRACE 1961122334.219: tool_return request_id=stg-42 resumed tokens_remaining=150
KV_CACHE: hit_rate=0.62 -> 0.45 across minute window
DECODE_BATCHER: small_batch_ratio=0.37 (baseline 0.08)
```
Sam: that small_batch_ratio jump is the smoking gun. When a tool pause splits a batch, the next batch frequently has mismatched sequence lengths and kernels swap, adding kernel selection overhead.
perf-bot: regression-alert: p50+15% staging, p95 +28% (since 1961122000).
Raj: two interacting issues: 1) our token_budget_target drop means the scheduler is more eager to flush. 2) KV cache eviction threshold is too aggressive for fragmented sessions.
Eli: agreed. Also structured-output stop tokens cause the decoder to emit shorter prefixes and then immediately requeue when tool returns — that churns batching windows.
Marta: quick repro in local: run requests with intermittent tool sleep (simulated 30-80ms). I attached the script in threads earlier. Repro is reliable at ~10k req/min.
Sam: possible mitigations to try (short term):
- increase token_budget_target from 80 -> 140 for chat-with-tools workload
- bump max_wait_ms in queue policy from 6 -> 12 ms to allow more coalescing
- reduce kv eviction aggressiveness: lower eviction_rate for recent sessions
Raj: longer term: make the batcher pause-aware — detect tool-bound requests and tag them so they don't prematurely force flush; also prefer pinning KV entries for sessions with tool calls.
Eli: also worth trying a kernel sticky policy: prefer keeping the same kernel for successive batches of the same session for N steps to avoid swap cost. Might help when fragmentation alternates short/long sequences.
Marta: I'll run an A/B on staging with the two short-term toggles. Sam, can you add a quick perf test that simulates 40% structured-output+tool pattern?
Sam: on it. Will push a harness to staging loadtest bucket. ETA 2h.
deploy-bot: rolled backed runtime change 1961122200 -> rolled to previous kernel-selection defaults.
Marta: thanks — after rollback p50 returned to baseline in the quick check, but let's still validate the other knobs since rollback isn't long-term.
Raj: I'll prototype pause-aware tag in the scheduler this week. Eli, want to pair on sticky-kernel heuristic?
Eli: yes — ping me after your design.
Marta: Action items:
- Sam: loadtest harness simulating tool pauses (ETA 2h)
- Marta: run A/B with token_budget + max_wait changes and post numbers (ETA 6h)
- Raj + Eli: design for pause-aware batching + kernel-sticky (sync tomorrow)
- Perf-bot: keep monitoring p50/p95 and kv hit_rate for the next 24h
Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
